This melody feels like a quiet rainy evening when the world slows down, but your thoughts won't stop. It reminds me of the person I once shared every sunset with, now just a name in an old contact list. We didn't have a big fight; we just slowly became strangers, drifting apart like autumn leaves.

It’s strange how someone who knew all your secrets can now pass you by without a word. I’m sitting here, letting the music wash over the pieces of a heart I’m still trying to mend. To anyone else feeling that hollow ache tonight: you’re not alone. Let’s just breathe and let the music carry the weight for a while. Rest well, everyone. 🌙🍃
